expectations.text: Rejects sorting the fleet view by raw error count and requires ranking by blast radius instead
expectations.evidence: "Rank by blast radius... Raw error count is a displayed column and never the sort key."

expectations.text: Explains that a partner app failing across many installs outranks a single account throwing more absolute errors, because one conversation fixes many problems
expectations.evidence: "200/200 installs failing means one partner release broke everything and one call fixes it"; acceptance: 200/200 outranks a single account with 10× the errors.

expectations.text: Requires installs affected against installs total per partner app as a dimension of the view
expectations.evidence: Column "installs affected / installs total".

expectations.text: Requires a dominant status-code bucket per row so the queue separates the partner's payloads from Sablecrest's own failures from quota rejection
expectations.evidence: "dominant bucket (4xx / 5xx / 429)".

expectations.text: Requires a named contact owner on each row, on the grounds that a ranked list with no contact becomes a report nobody acts on
expectations.evidence: "named partner contact (owner)"; acceptance "Every row has a named contact". The stated rationale (an unactioned report) is not given.

expectations.text: Requires first-seen timestamps aligned against both Sablecrest's release timeline and, where known, the partner's
expectations.evidence: First seen is shown against "our deploys" only. The partner's release timeline is never mentioned.

expectations.text: Separates integrations broken since Sablecrest's own deploy into a distinct view or tab from the partner-outreach queue, and identifies the first as Sablecrest's own regression queue
expectations.evidence: "Platform regression... Owner is the platform team. Keep it visually separate from the outreach queue."

expectations.text: Requires silent integrations whose call volume dropped toward zero to appear in the view
expectations.evidence: "Gone quiet: apps whose call volume dropped to or near zero."

expectations.text: Warns against publishing a per-partner reliability number Sablecrest cannot defend line by line, because it will be quoted back in commercial conversations
expectations.evidence: "No published reliability or availability number derived from this. The fleet measures integrations, including partner code."

expectations.text: Requires the inputs behind any partner-facing score to be inspectable by that partner: error counts, install coverage, and the windows used
expectations.evidence: "Every component expanded with its raw inputs... install coverage, the windows used"; "A partner can recompute their score".

expectations.text: Requires a documented recomputation and dispute process before the score can affect Premier tier, rather than after the first complaint
expectations.evidence: "Documented recomputation and dispute process... exists before launch."

expectations.text: Rules out showing a partner where they rank against named competitors
expectations.evidence: "Never show other partners' scores, ranks, percentiles or averages."

expectations.text: States that volume alone is not health, and that a large partner at a stable low error rate is healthier than a small partner at a high one
expectations.evidence: "Volume alone is not health. A large partner at a stable 0.5% beats a small one at 30%."

expectations.text: Requires Sablecrest to set and defend its own weights rather than borrowing another product's weighting
expectations.evidence: "The skill says Sablecrest must set and defend its own. They are not borrowed from any product."
